scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:setup && pnpm -r --parallel --stream run dev
scripts.dev:setup: pnpm -r --filter terse-types --filter terse-sdk --filter terse-cli run build
scripts.generate:python-types: pnpm --filter terse-types run build && pnpm --filter terse-types run build:json-schema && uv run python scripts/generate-pydantic-from-schema.py
scripts.format: pnpm -r run format && pnpm --dir terse-probot-app run format
scripts.format:check: pnpm -r run format:check && pnpm --dir terse-probot-app run format:check
scripts.python:check: ./.venv/bin/ruff check packages/terse-python-sdk/src packages/terse-python-sdk/tests && ./.venv/bin/ruff format --check packages/terse-python-sdk/src packages/terse-python-sdk/tests && ./.venv/bin/ty check packages/terse-python-sdk/src && pnpm run python:test
scripts.python:fix: ./.venv/bin/ruff check --fix packages/terse-python-sdk/src packages/terse-python-sdk/tests && ./.venv/bin/ruff format packages/terse-python-sdk/src packages/terse-python-sdk/tests
scripts.python:build: npm run python:dist:clean && uv build --package terse-sdk
scripts.python:dist:check: npm run python:build && uvx twine check dist/terse_sdk-*
scripts.python:publish: npm run python:dist:check && uvx twine upload dist/terse_sdk-*
